q: Which combination runs your agent privately on your own computer?
options: Ollama for the model and Open WebUI for the interface
explanation: Ollama runs an AI model on your computer and Open WebUI gives you a simple chat interface and knowledge base. n8n is added later, only after the agent gives reliable answers.

q: During testing, you give the agent an incomplete request. What should it do?
options: Send a message to the client
explanation: The agent brief instructs it to ask when context is missing. The 'missing context' test checks exactly this: an incomplete request should produce questions, not guesses.

q: Why must the first workflow stay read-only and require approval for actions?
options: Free tools do not support writing
The agent must never send, delete, publish or spend without your approval
Approval is only needed for financial tasks
explanation: The agent brief requires approval for any action — never send, delete, publish or spend without it. Keep secrets out, start read-only, and test before trusting the agent.
